# Keep the Light 1.24.0

- **Deinterlace.** Old TV shows, DVDs and recordings are often interlaced, so anything that moves has striped edges. Keep the Light now spots this by looking at the picture itself, because the files are often labelled wrong. It fixes it automatically, safely for HDR. **Smooth motion** (the default) keeps the fluid look of the original broadcast (50/60 fps); **Standard** keeps 25/30 fps. Tested on The Carol Burnett Show.
- **Time estimates for short files.** Queues of TV episodes now get time estimates after the first episode or two, instead of waiting forever.
- **Browse remembers where you were.** Each file and folder picker opens in the folder you last chose with it, even after a restart.
- **Layout and UI changes, UI-1 to UI-11.** Each one can be undone on its own if you don't like it: just say which number.
  - **UI-1** A **Fix** button on Plex warnings.
  - **UI-2** A compact **Checks** list under the file.
  - **UI-3** A one-line notice for missing optional tools.
  - **UI-4** The main button says exactly what it will do, and "When finished" moved to the Queue tab.
  - **UI-5** The file name is shown large, and the format reads "HEVC 10-bit".
  - **UI-6** Explanations sit behind a small **?**.
  - **UI-7** Empty screens show how to start.
  - **UI-8** Two-line queue rows with chips; click a row for its details.
  - **UI-9** Messages fade by themselves.
  - **UI-10** A language picker for tracks with no language.
  - **UI-11** Keyboard focus outlines and brighter grey text.
